info.title: Grants.gov Search API: federal grants list with deadlines
info.description:
Which federal grants are open right now? Searches Grants.gov and returns opportunity, agency, deadline, eligibility and the source link.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper
Author: Public Records.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Start a run and read dataset items

post.description: Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper

application/json.schema:
{
  "$schema": "https://apify.com/schemas/v1/input.ide.json",
  "title": "Grants.gov Opportunities Scraper",
  "description": "Public Grants.gov search2 API. No API key. Response token/accessKey are ignored. Server date filter: postedWithinDays → dateRange. open/close date fields are client-side (API does not support custom MM/DD ranges).",
  "type": "object",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "properties": {
    "keyword": {
      "title": "Keyword",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Search keyword (e.g. education, cybersecurity). Leave empty for all.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "default": "",
      "prefill": ""
    },
    "agency": {
      "title": "Agency",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Mapped to API body agencies (e.g. HHS, EPA, NSF).",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "default": "",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "status": {
      "title": "Opportunity status",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Mapped to API oppStatuses. Use forecasted|posted|closed|archived or pipe-joined.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "default": "forecasted|posted",
      "prefill": "posted"
    },
    "postedWithinDays": {
      "title": "Posted within N days",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Server-side filter mapped to search2 dateRange (posted-date lookback). Verified values: 3,7,14,21,28,35,42,49,56,90,180,365. Omit for no posted-date filter.",
      "editor": "number",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 3650,
      "nullable": true
    },
    "openDateFrom": {
      "title": "Open date from",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Client-side filter on openDate. Accepts MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive.",
      "editor": "datepicker",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "openDateTo": {
      "title": "Open date to",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Client-side filter on openDate. Inclusive.",
      "editor": "datepicker",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "closeDateFrom": {
      "title": "Close date from",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Client-side filter on closeDate. Inclusive. Useful for 'still open' windows.",
      "editor": "datepicker",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "closeDateTo": {
      "title": "Close date to",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Client-side filter on closeDate. Inclusive.",
      "editor": "datepicker",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "maxItems": {
      "title": "Max items",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Cap on opportunity rows (deduped by opportunityId).",
      "default": 50,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 5000
    },
    "fetchDetails": {
      "title": "Fetch opportunity details",
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Hydrate synopsis via fetchOpportunity. Still one PPE charge per opportunity.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
